title: Apple Orchard

serves.summary: The learner packs a collection of up to 120 apples into crates of ten, stacks the full crates, and writes the numeral for how many (47, 104, 120), which shows counting to 120 by making tens and writing numbers past 100.

request.topic: Counting a collection to 120 by making tens
request.objective: Count a collection of up to 120 objects by making groups of ten and write the numeral for how many.

problems.ask: Pack the morning's apples into crates of 10, then write how many apples there are.
problems.goal: 4 crates of 10 on the shelf, 7 apples left, and the number written is 47.

problems.ask: Pack the apples into crates of 10 to count them all, then write how many apples there are.
problems.goal: 10 crates of 10 on the shelf, 4 apples left, and the number written is 104.

problems.ask: A big harvest! Pack the apples into crates of 10 and write how many apples there are.
problems.goal: 12 crates of 10 on the shelf, none left, and the number written is 120.
